name: Old Fresno Water Tower
scope: The extant Old Fresno Water Tower exterior, including the Romanesque shaft, circular balcony, projecting stair turret and red tiled cap.
era: The exterior after its 2001 adaptation as a visitors’ centre, with exterior detail from the 2011 cleared original.

originalReview.notes: The exact Wikimedia original shows the warm painted shaft, circular oculus, smaller hanging turret, ornate iron balcony and the upper arcaded cornice.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: The exact Qualla CC0 field photograph established the exterior finish, main profile and visible details. National Register text oriented the entry and the county supplied the height.
